Item.name: ORBLongBreakout_NYSession
Item.help: Long ORB breakout, identical entry geometry to ORBLongBreakout, but ANDed with the DST-aware NY cash-session gate (PF_NYSessionWindow logic) so the Builder cannot generate/keep a variant that enters outside the legal 09:30-16:00 America/New_York window. Built for NDXm (feed timezone EET).
